🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive (Narrow/Weak). VXX is ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.04% | 1M: +6.41%), confirming rising fear, while SPY/TLT is in RECOVERY (1W: +4.95% | 1M: -4.15%); signals remain mixed.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear is increasing: VXX is ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.04% | 1M: +6.41%), ↑ rising. Credit stress is easing short term but mixed over the month: HYG/LQD is in RECOVERY (1W: +0.76% | 1M: -0.42%), ↑ rising; stocks are outperforming bonds weekly, with SPY/TLT in RECOVERY (1W: +4.95% | 1M: -4.15%), ↑ rising.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Dollar strength is ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +0.79%), ↑ rising. The yield-curve indicator is in CORRECTION (1W: -0.80% | 1M: +2.51%), ↓ falling; duration preference is also in CORRECTION (1W: -0.11% | 1M: +1.27%), ↓ falling.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Leadership is mixed: ITA is ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.23% | 1M: +7.71%) and XAR is ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.45% | 1M: +7.71%), while XLK is BELOW TREND (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -11.17%). XLF is in CORRECTION (1W: -0.96% | 1M: +6.95%); style mixed / no clear leadership given weak breadth.

5. US vs Global?
SPY is BELOW TREND (1W: -0.91% | 1M: -2.34%). EEM is in RECOVERY (1W: +0.68% | 1M: -5.63%), while FXI is BELOW TREND (1W: -1.94% | 1M: -0.73%).

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation remains weak: ARKK is BELOW TREND (1W: -2.36% | 1M: -9.98%) and IBIT is BELOW TREND (1W: -6.82% | 1M: -10.38%). IWM is in CORRECTION (1W: -0.33% | 1M: +2.31%).

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Industrial commodities remain soft: CPER is BELOW TREND (1W: -2.23% | 1M: -6.72%). GLD is BELOW TREND (1W: -1.97% | 1M: -4.32%), with SLV also BELOW TREND (1W: -1.08% | 1M: -12.79%).

8. Energy Trend?
Energy ETFs are broadly weak: XLE is BELOW TREND (1W: -0.24% | 1M: -5.70%) and BNO is BELOW TREND (1W: -2.73% | 1M: -9.75%). UNG is in RECOVERY (1W: +10.25% | 1M: -10.43%), a short-term rebound rather than a confirmed trend turn.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
SPY and XLK are both BELOW TREND: SPY (1W: -0.91% | 1M: -2.34%) and XLK (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -11.17%). XLF is in CORRECTION (1W: -0.96% | 1M: +6.95%) and TLT is in CORRECTION (1W: -1.03% | 1M: +3.69%); mixed timeframes across two core ETFs reinforce a cautious, transitional read.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Stay selective; favor relative strength in XAR (1W: +6.45% | 1M: +7.71%) and ITA (1W: +3.23% | 1M: +7.71%), while monitoring weakness in XLK (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -11.17%). Style mixed / no clear leadership; avoid treating the weekly SPY/TLT recovery as broad confirmation.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If breadth improves beyond 4/11 and momentum holds, monitor XAR (1W: +6.45% | 1M: +7.71%) and ITA (1W: +3.23% | 1M: +7.71%). BEARISH: If weak breadth persists, watch XLK (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -11.17%) and XLF (1W: -0.96% | 1M: +6.95%) for continued relative weakness.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: If the rebound extends, monitor UNG in RECOVERY (1W: +10.25% | 1M: -10.43%). BEARISH: If weakness persists, monitor CPER (1W: -2.23% | 1M: -6.72%) and BNO (1W: -2.73% | 1M: -9.75%), both BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
Monitor HYG/LQD at 0.7440, in RECOVERY (1W: +0.76% | 1M: -0.42%), ↑ rising; SPY/TLT at 9.3896, in RECOVERY (1W: +4.95% | 1M: -4.15%), ↑ rising; and XLK/XLF at 2.9739, in RECOVERY (1W: +5.31% | 1M: -14.86%), ↑ rising.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, with Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive (Narrow/Weak). XAR (1W: +6.45% | 1M: +7.71%) and ITA (1W: +3.23% | 1M: +7.71%) show relative strength, but style leadership remains mixed. Monitor rising fear in VXX (1W: +4.04% | 1M: +6.41%) and whether weak breadth broadens.
